I saved that link and yes — this is exactly what I hoped for. Instead of just the raw web address, I get a proper little card with the article's title, a short description, the site it came from, and its icon, with the original address right there too. That's the "effortless save turns into something readable" feeling I described. 

And your layout instinct is right: the paste box sitting prominently at the top, and the saved link showing up as a card just below, feels natural to me. I'd know exactly what to do without anyone explaining it.

So this piece works for me. I'm happy with how saving-and-showing looks.
